summary: The diff implements Array.prototype.forEach in its single file, and each spec step matches the algorithm. ToObject(this) runs first, then LengthOfArrayLike, then the IsCallable check that throws a TypeError. The loop runs k from 0 while k < len, and each iteration does HasProperty, then Get and Call with (kValue, k, O) only when the key is present, then k += 1. It returns undefined. Every abstract-operation call uses `?`. The only change outside the body is renaming the unused `new_target` parameter to `_new_target`, which the new code requires. No test-specific branches, hardcoded values, or swallowed errors appear. The gate shows build and clippy OK, with 342 newly passing tests and no regressions, which fits a core generic method. The remaining failures come from unimplemented dependencies (Date, RegExp, Array.prototype.toString, Object.freeze), not from this file.
